raw.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

das erwartet dich bei ida

  • Als CTO übernimmst du die strategische Leitung unserer Tech-Unit und den rund 40 Mitarbeiter:innen, die zur Unit gehören.

  • Dein Fokus liegt dabei nicht auf der operativen Arbeit in Projekten, sondern auf dem Steuern: Du gibst der Unit Richtung, sorgst für Verbindlichkeit und schaffst die Rahmenbedingungen, unter denen unsere Teams ihr Bestes geben können.

  • Gemeinsam mit unseren Teamleads verantwortest du die fachliche und personelle Weiterentwicklung der Unit: Du entwickelst also Menschen und Strukturen, statt selbst zu programmieren.

  • Unterdessen behältst du selbstredend die Auslastung und Kapazitäten der Unit im Blick und sorgst mit vorausschauender Ressourcen- und Kapazitätsplanung dafür, dass unsere Teams weder über- noch unterlastet sind.

  • Als unser:e CTO verfolgst du Technologie-Trends für ida, kennst die aktuellen Entwicklungen und Workflows bei der Umsetzung komplexer Softwareprojekte und treibst insbesondere das Thema KI aktiv voran – von der strategischen Einordnung bis zum konkreten Nutzen für unsere Arbeit und die unserer Kund:innen.

  • Apropos: Ohne unsere Kund:innen wären wir nichts. Daher stimmst du die technologische Vision eng mit ihnen ab und begleitest sie als Sparringspartner:in auf ihrem Weg.

  • Zudem challengst du unsere Aufwandsschätzungen und technischen Konzepte für größere Projekte und Ausschreibungen, hinterfragst sie konstruktiv und hilfst uns auf diese Weise, realistisch zu planen und sauber zu liefern.

  • Darüber hinaus bist du ein zentraler Teil des ida-Managements, nimmst wesentlichen Einfluss auf die strategische Ausrichtung sowie die Portfolioentwicklung unserer Agentur und bist verantwortlich für relevante KPIs und Budgets.

  • Du arbeitest lieber remote oder im Office? Wir können beides, ganz wie du willst.

  • Besonders schön: Bei ida hast du die Möglichkeit, die Angebote der öffentlich-rechtlichen Rundfunkanstalten und anderer Medienhäuser maßgeblich mitzugestalten und zu verbessern – und damit einen positiven Beitrag für unsere Gesellschaft zu leisten.

das bringst du mit

  • Unerlässlich: Du hast fundierte Führungserfahrung im agilen Kontext und Erfahrung im Führung von Führungskräften. Das heißt, du verstehst dich in erster Linie als Manager:in und Enabler:in und nicht als operativ mitarbeitende:r Entwickler:in.

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit und Eigeninitiative sind deine echten Stärken. Das bedeutet, du triffst Absprachen, hältst sie ein und gehst Themen von dir aus an, statt darauf zu warten, dass dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist.

  • Daher ist es auch besonders wichtig, dass du Probleme nicht nur benennst, sondern sie auch selbst löst und so in deiner Rolle maßgeblich die Kultur bei ida mitprägst: Vorbildwirkung und so ...

  • Zudem bringst du ein gutes technologisches Verständnis mit und hast ein Gespür für Technologie-Trends, Tools und Practices sowie ihre Relevanz fürs Geschäft, aber again: tiefe Hands-on-Coding-Praxis ist ausdrücklich keine Voraussetzung für den Job.

  • Klar, dass du unterdessen auch ein sehr gutes Netzwerk in der Tech-Branche pflegst und es stetig weiter ausbaust.

  • Und wenn du darüber hinaus bereits Erfahrungen in einer Digitalagentur und/oder in einem Medienhaus gesammelt hast, dann wäre das natürlich die Kirsche auf dem Milchshake.

was uns besonders wichtig ist

Diversität ist etwas, wonach wir streben. FLINTA* , BIPoC, LGBTQIA+ und Menschen mit Behinderung möchten wir daher ganz ausdrücklich ermutigen, sich bei ida zu bewerben. Wir haben hier einige Anforderungen aufgeschrieben, aber du erfüllst nicht alle? Macht nix. Wir freuen uns auf dich.

Du sagst, das könnte passen? Dann lass uns miteinander reden! Schick deine Bewerbung mit deinem Lebenslauf, frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung direkt an uns über unser Bewerbungsformular.

raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Immuware)
raw.excerpt: Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare.
raw.description:
Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem.

As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce.

About the Role

Immuware's customers, including Employee Health nurses; occupational health managers; and compliance professionals, work in one of the most requirement-heavy environments in healthcare IT. Regulations shift. Organizational structures change. New workflows emerge. Each of these changes often means hands-on work is needed inside their Immuware environment.

The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) exists to meet that need. It's a technical role embedded in the post-sales customer experience. It is not account management, not billable project work, and not break-fix support. The FDE shows up on customer calls, understands exactly what a health-system nurse manager is trying to accomplish, and gets it done. This is a process that happens through configuration, scripting, integrations, or code, and by partnering with product and engineering when the problem is bigger than one person.

The FDE owns the technical depth: live solutioning, hands-on building, and the bridge between customer needs and internal product and engineering teams.

What You'll Do

As our Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will own the technical resolution of customer problems end to end, from understanding the need, building the fix, landing it with product and engineering when it's bigger than you, to ultimately serve as the bridge between customer needs and internal product and engineering teams. You're measured on customer outcomes, not on activity.
This role partners closely with our Customer Success Managers, who own the overall customer relationship, strategy, and commercial outcomes.


Technical Solutioning & Building

  • Lead regular (often weekly) technical working sessions with customers to address actively evolving needs driven by regulatory changes, organizational shifts, and workflow updates.

  • Configure, script, and-where it's the right tool-write code to solve customer needs: workflow setup, rule-building, field configuration, user and role management, reporting, data corrections, integrations, and small platform changes.

  • Translate complex Employee Health requirements (OSHA compliance, state-specific immunization mandates, system credentialing workflows, and the like) into solutions that actually work for our clients, in the Immuware platform (open to suggestions!) .

  • Question the requirements: Challenge requests that don't serve the customer's real goal, and choose the simplest solution that solves the underlying problem.

  • Thoroughly document your solution designs in Notion, while updating live items in Jira, to ensure they are repeatable and transferable.

  • Generalize your work. Turn one-off fixes into reusable templates, decision trees, or product improvements so the next customer benefits.

  • Triage net-new module or record-type additions that need a formal Letter of Work (LOW) and/or an ARR change (expansion) to CSMs and Professional Services.

Customer Partnership

  • Serve as the technical counterpart to CSMs on customer calls. CSMs handle the relationship; you handle "how do we make it work."

  • Working alongside the CSMs, lead deeper, in-depth customer education beyond basic platform navigation, run workflow specific walkthroughs, and re-train as staff turnover and organizational change creates knowledge gaps.

  • Build trusted-advisor relationships with power users and technical contacts at customer organizations.

  • Spot configuration gaps or risks before they turn into escalations.

  • Stay aware of each assigned customer's environment, history, and upcoming needs.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

  • Partner directly with product and engineering: open pull requests, pair on fixes, and reproduce or root-cause issues in the codebase where you can.

  • Monitoring surface patterns across customers: repeated requests, regulatory gaps, and workflow limitations, and bring them to Product with specificity and customer context.

  • Contribute to the internal knowledge base: common configurations, decision trees, scripts, and workarounds, so the team scales.

Support Bridge & Scoping

  • Fix what you can, and hand off a clean, dev-ready ticket for what you can't. Identify potential bugs or system issues, partner with development to solve for the root cause, and reproduce solutions at scale.

  • Write clear, well-scoped bug reports and feature requests that enable engineering to act without back-and-forth.

  • Confidently identify and navigate between "I can fix this," "this needs a support ticket," and "this needs a product change."

What This Role Is Not

  • Not account ownership. CSMs own renewals, expansion, and the executive relationship. The FDE supports those relationships through technical excellence.

  • Not billable Professional Services. PS handles formal implementation projects with SOWs. The FDE handles ongoing, post-go-live technical needs as part of the customer's subscription.

  • Not the L1/L2 support queue. The support team owns routine bug triage. This FDE will do deeper scoping and fixes, ensuring a clean handoff. It does not replace the support workflow.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

  • Are energized by customer calls and like solving problems live, not async.

  • Can read a healthcare compliance requirement and immediately start thinking about how to model and build it in a SaaS platform.

  • Have a builder's mindset: you're systematic, you test your own work, you write code when it's the right tool, and you don't leave a solution half-done.

  • Can switch comfortably between explaining something to an IT admin, a head nurse, a customer executive, and your own engineering team.

  • Are naturally organized. You manage several customers with different environments and needs at once.

  • Get frustrated by workarounds and push internally for real solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation consultant, technical account manager, or forward deployed engineer) handling client resolutions, both live (virtually) and post meeting action items, and know how to navigate delays while staying calm under pressure and maintaining the clients trust.

  • 4-5 years navigating Azure, JavaScript, and Typescript with a strong background in SQL and Azure SQL database management.

  • Drive and ownership: You are comfortable and familiar with identifying the crux of large, enterprise customers' problems and outline additional potential issues as well. Then you own the solution outcome, driving these problems to resolution on your own instead of handing them off.

  • Strong written and verbal communication: You're credible with a customer's executives and technical staff and with internal product and engineering teams, and comfortable leading technical working sessions with non-technical stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

60 days: Lead a solo engagement

After two months, you are now independently leading a scoped customer sync, having built trust with customers technical teams, and delivering against customer requirements and timelines.

90 days: Own multiple, concurrent engagements

At three months in, you are now independently managing multiple healthcare customer engagements, contributing reusable playbooks and tooling, and surfacing product feedback that helps convert bespoke implementation patterns into scalable capabilities.

raw.excerpt: About FyxerSince launching in May 2024 we've grown to $30 million in ARR.
raw.description:
About Fyxer

Since launching in May 2024 we've grown to $30 million in ARR. Fyxer is building an AI executive assistant that handles emails, scheduling and follow-up, freeing people in client-facing roles to focus on their customers.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the hardest technical tickets in the business end to end, including the customer conversation, from first report through to resolution

  • Dogfood Fyxer’s own products, give feedback, and influence our roadmap

  • Establish blast radius before escalating, because one customer reporting something is a ticket and forty-seven accounts in the same broken state is an incident

  • Call bug, incident or user error correctly and quickly, and declare it when it's an incident

  • Write escalations Engineering can act on without a single follow-up question, and stay on them until they land

  • Spot patterns across Linear and the queue, raising a tracker before the fifth report of something becomes the tenth

  • Reduce the need for your own role through runbooks, saved queries, Parahelp knowledge, and hands-on upskilling of our senior agents

Here's the honest version of why this role exists. In one recent three-month window we escalated 47 tickets to Engineering and two of them were resolved. Engineering is capacity-constrained, and a third of what we sent them was correctly deprioritised. So this isn't a role that escalates better, it's one that resolves. You'll be backed by strong Customer Success and Product Engineering teams, and given read-only access to our codebase through Cursor, to our data through our internal tooling, and to our production logs to do it.

What Success Looks Like

  • You resolve a growing share of technical escalations without Engineering ever being involved

  • Your escalations are complete, so Engineer can act on them quickly

  • You use AI and you catch it when it's wrong, before it reaches a customer

  • You hold a customer's confidence while you investigate, rather than handing them back to someone else

  • Our senior agents are visibly more capable six months in than they are today, because of you

  • You're the person the team wants on the ticket because they trust your judgement.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in a technical support role within a SaaS or cloud-based company

  • API fluency: you can read an API reference, reason about authentication, and say what a 401 rather than a 500 tells you about where the fault sits

  • SQL you write yourself: given an unfamiliar schema you work out how the tables relate and write the join unaided

  • Comfortable in logs, following a request across services and working backwards from an error

  • Strong written communication, particularly to a customer who is unhappy

  • Experience with customer support tools such as Zendesk, Intercom, Jira, Linear, others

  • Startup-ready: adaptable, fast-moving, and hands-on

We're not asking for production engineering experience or a computer science degree. We care what you can do, not how you got there.

Location and other bits

  • Based in our Chancery Lane office in London, Monday to Thursday, with Fridays from home

  • Standard office hours

  • Benefits include: on-site gym, private medical, pension and lunch provided everyday

The Hiring Process

  1. Submit your CV (no need for a cover letter)

  2. We'll review it

  3. An initial call with someone from the hiring team to review your experience and motivation for joining (30 mins)

  4. A call with our Head of Customer Support on your experience and how you think technically (30 minutes)

  5. A live technical exercise (60 minutes)

  6. Meet more of the team (30 minutes)

For the exercise we'll give you access to a small example application, a database, an API and its logs, a couple of days ahead, along with three customer tickets. You don't need to solve anything in advance, and you're welcome to use whatever AI tooling you normally would, because that's how the job actually works. We'll be paying attention to how you check its answers.

Our Culture

Our culture is intentional. It stems from the fact we're in the race of our lives to reshape one of the largest AI opportunities that exist; email. There is only first or last.

We're going to win by:

  • An obsession around the fact that every second counts, we have to move fast with intensity and drive hard every day.

  • Never let it slide, be relentless in challenging yourself and others to strive for the best outcome.

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we'll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

Compensation Range: £65K - £75K

Job Title: Senior Director Clinical Development, Solid Tumor

Job Location: Remote (US)

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

At BeOne, our Global Development SuperHighway — our integrated, end-to-end, wholly internal development capability — is a cornerstone of our R&D vision. It brings together a unique set of internal cross-functional capabilities from across the globe needed for efficient delivery of clinical trials to develop impactful medicines to accelerate access to innovation for patients around the world.

We are now opening this same delivery engine to the world’s most promising external science. Through SuperHighway partnerships, highly promising assets from leading biotech partners can access our development capabilities creating a true win-win ecosystem with the ultimate goal of helping more patients around the world. This is not a fee-for-service model; it is a bold new way to grow the company and expand what’s possible in oncology. This is a rare opportunity to help build something genuinely new — joining a high-caliber, agile team at the leading edge of clinical development innovation. If you are energized by building, by challenging the status quo, and by making a real impact on patients’ lives, this is where you belong.

The Clinical Development Lead is accountable for developing clinical program strategy and assuring that activities are executed within expected scope, budget, and timelines for our partnership programs under the Development SuperHighway. The Lead provides clinical development leadership and co-works with other core-team members to ensure successful delivery by the execution functions.
This role helps deliver the partnership studies that run on our Clinical SuperHighway, supporting seamless onboarding and high-quality execution of external partner projects in close partnership with the execution functions.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Accountable for clinical development strategy and development of clinical development plan that meet worldwide regulatory and commercial/access needs for the partnership program assets.
  • Within the partnership program, make recommendations in clinical development area and accountable for planning and ensuring the high-quality and compliant results submitted to regulatory agencies.
  • Partner with other core-team members in the partnership program and Execution Units for the successful implementation and execution of clinical studies.
  • Provide scientific expertise for selection of investigator and vendors.
  • Provide scientific and medical guidance/support throughout conduct of a clinical trial.
  • Review, query, and analyze clinical trial data.
  • Interpret, and present clinical trial data both internally and externally.
  • Build and maintain opinion leader/investigator networks; organize and present at key opinion leader advisory boards and investigator meetings.
  • Facilitate generation of, author, update, and/or review key documents, including, but not limited to protocol concepts, synopses, protocols, and amendments, informed consent documents, Investigator Brochures, Clinical study reports, abstracts, posters and manuscripts, as well as clinical sections of INDs (and equivalent applications), NDAs (and equivalent applications), Annual Reports, and Developmental Safety Update Reports, Clinical sections of Health Authority Briefing Documents, Orphan Drug applications, and annual reports, risks / benefits analysis for applicable documents, Clinical Development Plans etc.
  • Provide responses to queries relating to study design, analysis, and interpretation posed by the clinical monitors, regulatory agencies, investigators, and CROs etc.
  • Consult with Advisory Committee for relevant topics and incorporate the ideas into strategy and execution if appropriate.
  • Provide guidance/training to function team in Execution Unit, CRO staff and study site staff on the therapeutical area, molecule, and/or clinical protocol and may provide coach and mentorship to the team members working on the assets when there’s performance concern and for team development purpose.
  • Conduct regular review meetings with Execution Units with the partnership program core team to mentor, support, and ensure all studies are tracking to quality and timeline.
  • Report on study status, goals, operational KPIs, and enforce quality KPIs.
  • Champions a global mindset and approach across Global Development to foster collaboration and consistency across the organization.
  • Point of escalation for all assets’ related issues and report back to the partnership program core team for discussion and alignment.
  • Contribute to or perform therapeutic area/indication research and competitor analysis.
  • Participate company-wise standard discussion, finalization, and implementation.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education Required:

  • MD, DO degree or equivalent in a related discipline required, with a minimum of 6+ years of clinical development experience including 5 or more years in oncology therapeutic area.
  • 10+ years preferred

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Manages direct reports (e.g., Medical Directors / Clinical Scientists) supporting the assigned partnership programs.

Computer Skills:

  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite

Other Qualifications:

  • Professional knowledge and skills in oncology therapeutics required.
  • Strategic leader with demonstrated success building, managing, and developing teams.
  • Working knowledge of applicable international compliance guidelines and regulations.
  • Experience working in a global environment required; deep understanding of immuno-oncology strongly desired.
  • Fluent in written and verbal English;

Travel:

  • Up to 20%. Ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $299,800.00 - $369,800.00 annually

BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. raw.description:
WordPress VIP is the world’s leading enterprise content management platform. We help leading companies and organizations (including NASA, Salesforce, and Disney) create powerful digital experiences with WordPress.

As Senior Manager, Demand Generation at WordPress VIP, you bring deep craft expertise in demand generation and lifecycle marketing from lead creation through closed/won opportunities. You’ll build our demand generation strategy across integrated programs in our priority industries: Media, Public Sector, and Corporate (including Manufacturing & Industrial, Technology, and BFSI (Banking, Financial Services and Insurance).

You’ll draw on a shared AI Intelligence Layer (Product Marketing, AI agents, customer insight) for industry depth and insights on demand—working with AI agents the way other marketers work with juniors: brief them, review the output, ship what’s good, retrain what isn’t.

You’re T-shaped, AI-fluent, and strong with data. You bring serious depth in demand generation and credible breadth across the rest of the integrated marketing motion, with experience marketing to enterprise audiences. You read a pipeline report, interrogate it, and decide what to do differently.

What you own

  • Your craft anchor: Always-on demand generation strategy. You’ll own the continuous strategy for lifecycle (lead through to closed/won), email, content syndication, and new demand programs and channels. This includes running campaigns as your own programs, including Tier 1 product launches, and balancing top-of-funnel always-on campaigns with demand gen plays.
  • Multi-channel, multi-touch programs: Anchored in conversion rate optimization and designed to convert leads to SQLs; executing holistic programs including content, email, and landing pages in collaboration with Marketing Ops, Web, Paid Media, and Integrated Marketers.
  • Opportunity-led plays: You spot and respond to revenue opportunities as they emerge: a major industry moment, an inbound surge, a competitive shift, a partner play. Our internal Pipeline Council surfaces signals weekly, and you mobilize with the right mix of channels and assets. For some sprints, you anchor on one industry; for others, you run programs spanning three or four. You can flex without ever losing the thread.
  • Working the AI intelligence layer: You shape AI insights and understand that intelligence is only useful if the team using it makes it better. You use AI agents and skills in your day-to-day workflow. Agents do the volume work; you do the judgment work.
  • Cross-team operating: You work as part of a team of senior integrated marketers, including strategists in Partner Marketing, Experiential Marketing, ABM, and a Paid Media Strategist.

What you bring

Craft
Strong B2B enterprise marketing experience, ideally enterprise SaaS or technology. You will have proven experience owning and running programs that move pipeline.

An understanding of lifecycle marketing. You have built lifecycle programs from scratch, made data-driven optimization decisions, and moved lead-to-Closed/Won conversion metrics.

Proficiency in marketing analytics platforms, with deep fluency in Google Analytics—independently configuring conversion events, tracking, and reporting infrastructure, plus experience with Tableau, Looker, and A/B testing tools.

Ideally, you have experience with Demandbase, 6sense and Hubspot.

AI fluencyYou actively use AI tools in your work today. Not as a novelty, but as infrastructure. You have a point of view on what AI does well, where it fails, and where the human still earns the call.

You’re comfortable briefing agents, building skills, reviewing outputs critically, and iterating prompts and workflows.

You see AI as a leverage multiplier for senior marketers, not a threat to the craft.

Data fluencyYou read dashboards before meetings, not after. You pull your own data, build your own views, and ask sharper follow-up questions than the report shows.

You make decisions from data without being paralyzed by it. You know when the data is good enough to move and when it’s not. You can tell the story behind the numbers in a way executive leadership can act on. What worked. What didn’t. What to do next.

You will collaborate closely with Marketing Ops and our finance team to build and maintain dashboards, providing ongoing insights and clear reporting on campaign results.

How you operate

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and re-prioritization. Our AI model is built to flex; you flex with it.
  • Strong collaborator. The team only works if peers genuinely partner, share, and trust each other.
  • Bias to ship. Programs in market beat programs in planning.
  • Curious about the industries you’ll work across. You don’t need to be a Financial Services or Public Sector expert on day one, but you need the curiosity to get smart fast.

Qualifications

  • Strong B2B enterprise marketing experience, ideally enterprise SaaS or technology. Track record of running growth programs that move pipeline and revenue, not just produce activity.
  • Proficiency in marketing analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Tableau, Looker) and experience with A/B testing tools.
  • Significant experience leading demand generation programs that have meaningfully shifted acquisition, progression and expansion metrics.
  • Hands-on AI fluency. You use AI agents and LLM-based tools as part of your day-to-day workflow, and can brief, review, and iterate on agent outputs at a senior level.
  • Strong data fluency. Comfortable pulling your own data, building your own views, interrogating dashboards, and making sharp calls from imperfect inputs.
  • Experience operating in environments that prioritize speed and re-prioritization over fixed annual plans. You’re comfortable with sprint cadences and shifting scope.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Brand & Growth, and Customer Success. You don’t just build deliverables; you build trust with peers.

Note: We are only considering candidates based in North America at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary range: $140,000 - $180,000 USD. Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency.

We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic. Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated.

This isn’t your typical work-from-home job: we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. Read more about our compensation philosophy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our Benefits Page. And check out these links to learn more about How We Hire and What We Expect from Ourselves.

About Automattic

Now in our 20th year, we’re the people behind , WooCommerce, Beeper, Tumblr, Simplenote, Jetpack, Longreads, Day One, PocketCasts, and more. We believe in making the web a better place.

We’re a distributed company with more than 1500 Automatticians in nearly every corner of the globe, speaking over a hundred different languages. Enriched by this diversity, we’re united by a singular mission: to democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source. In short, we help maintain a balance in society, creating and continually refining powerful tools people can use to compete fairly—regardless of income, gender, politics, language, or where they live in the world.

We believe in Open Source, and the vast majority of our work is available under the GPL. Automattic is a Most Loved Company, an Equal Opportunity employer, and Disability Confident Committed. Each year, 12 million individuals resort to high-interest loans, often becoming trapped in a cycle of perpetual debt. We aim to put an end to this cycle and revolutionize the personal finance industry.

Joining us now presents an exceptional opportunity to play a pivotal role in DebtHammer's growth journey, working closely with the company's founder. Although our team is currently small, we are rapidly expanding.

We are seeking individuals to join our operations team—individuals who are enthusiastic about building a long-term career with us. Overview

As a Consumer Sales Representative at DebtHammer, your mission is to drive revenue for the company. Your primary responsibility will be engaging with potential customers actively seeking loan relief. Once engaged, representatives use open-ended questions and active listening to understand the needs of the customer and position DebtHammer as the best solution. It will be your responsibility to ensure that our customers have an amazing experience with DebtHammer and perceive us as the go-to solution for this industry.

Currently, 100% of our customers are inbound, meaning they searched online, found one of our websites, and indicated that they are looking for payday loan relief.

We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a seismic shift like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll do this decade.

raw.description:
About Wunderkind:Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue. Founded in 2010, Our goal is to scale a brand’s ability to create and grow customer relationships through websites, email, text, and ads. We believe individuals should have the freedom to choose the kind of internet they want. An internet that fosters genuine relationships with brands. An internet that treats humans like real people instead of “web traffic.” We also believe in empowering brands to treat their customers as individuals, satisfying their unique needs with tailored experiences and thoughtful communication. By expertly personalizing, automating, and scaling beautiful one-to-one experiences, Wunderkind helps brands acquire new customers at scale and keep them loyal for life.

Role Overview

Are you a master translator who can take complex, deeply technical product blueprints and turn them into high-converting, value-driven GTM narratives? Do you love the science of learning but hate the slow, traditional bottlenecks of old-school L&D?

We are looking for a Senior Manager, GTM Enablement to bridge the gap between our Product engine and our commercial teams (primarily Sales & Customer Success). As a team of one, you won't just be managing a process; you will be architecting a scalable, AI-augmented enablement engine. You will partner closely with Product, Solution Consulting, and Product Marketing to ensure our GTM teams deeply understand our new products, technical capabilities, and real-world use cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate Technical to Commercial: Convert complex product briefs and technical documentation into digestible, high-impact enablement programs and assets for Sales and CS.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the strategic connective tissue between Product, Solution Consulting, Strategy Consulting, and Product Marketing (PMM).
  • Program Design & Delivery: Apply strong L&D methodologies to design learning paths, certification programs, and interactive workshops that ensure product knowledge actually sticks.
  • Scale with AI: Act as a force multiplier. Because this is a standalone role, you will leverage AI tooling (LLMs, agentic solutions, and automation) to build content, generate training materials, and scale enablement across the organization.
  • Partner with Tech Experts: Work hand-in-hand with Solution Consultants to distill advanced technical features into clear, value-oriented customer use cases

What You Bring (Requirements)

  • Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in GTM Enablement, Product Marketing, Technical Enablement, or a closely related L&D function.
  • SaaS Expertise (Strong Preference): A deep understanding of the fast-paced nature of SaaS environments, product release cycles, and commercial motions.
  • The "Product Whisperer" Gene: Proven ability to sit with engineers and product managers, understand the technical "how," and independently translate it into the commercial "why."
  • AI Literacy: Hands-on, practical experience using AI tools (e.g., advanced prompting, LLM workflows, agentic software) to automate content creation and scale your individual output.
  • L&D Mindset: A strong grasp of instructional design, modern adult learning principles, and how to measure enablement efficacy beyond just "completion rates."

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves)

  • A sharp understanding of the priorities, KPIs, and pain points of Marketing Leaders (knowing what makes them tick helps you align our product value proposition to executive buyers).

What Success Looks Like in 60 Days: You have mapped out our upcoming product roadmap, and our past launches, established a seamless intake process with the Product and Solution Consulting teams, and deployed your first AI-assisted enablement sprint to the Sales and CS orgs.


The base salary range for this role is $105,000.00 to $120,000.00 Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. This may vary depending on living location and market rate.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose:

Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

About the role and what you'll be doing:

Ensono seeks a Director of Strategic Pursuits within our Global Solutions Organization to lead multi-tower and large deal pursuits. You will oversee a team of pre-sales Solution Principals and Architects, directing large, multi-tower deal solutioning that drives substantial revenue and positions Ensono as a trusted strategic partner. You'll balance business development, execution excellence, team development, and thought leadership to build a world-class solutions organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leadership & Team Management: Recruit, mentor, and retain a high-performing team of Solution Principals and Architects. Foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence, and client focus. Develop career paths and provide coaching to support individual and team growth.
  • Business Development & Client Relationships: Build and cultivate senior-level advisory relationships with C-suite executives at existing and prospective clients. Convert initial relationships into multi-assignment, long-term engagements that drive recurring revenue and expand market share for Ensono’s Transformation and Managed Services.
  • Partnering with Sales and Lead Generation: Establish a working partnership with Ensono’s Lead Generation and Field Sales teams to support our Go-to-Market strategies end to end. Plan resource allocation and timelines for pursuits in partnership with Sales. Ensure that solutions (architectures) are technically sound, scalable, and deliver measurable business value, and have alignment from investment, and delivery & operations teams.
  • Deal Solutioning & Delivery: Lead complex, multi-tower consultative engagements, directing technical strategy, approach, and execution. Actively participate on key client assignments, ensuring superior quality, on-time and on-budget execution, and measurable business impact.
  • Practice Development & Operations: Develop and execute a blueprint for scaling the Strategic Pursuits functions and the Global Solutions Organizations. Establish disciplined pursuit strategies, execution frameworks, and KPIs to increase market share, brand awareness, and recurring revenue. Track pursuit health, identify process gaps, and drive continuous improvements.
  • Quality & Impact: Champion a Strategic Solution Architecture practice known for deep client impact and tangible, measurable results. Ensure work undertaken aligns with Ensono's core strengths (hybrid platforms, mission-critical applications, digital transformation, etc.) and attracts top talent.
  • Thought Leadership & Market Presence: Author white papers, present at industry conferences, present to advisors, and represent Ensono at external forums to establish the practice's authority in advisory and consulting. Collaborate across business lines to reinforce Ensono's position as a "One Firm" trusted adviser.

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply. 

What You Will Need:

  • 20+ years of professional sales, solutioning, consulting, advisory, and/or Big 4 consulting experience
  • 5+ years of direct management and leadership experience building and scaling high-performing teams in client facing roles
  • Proven track record of managing revenue-generating practices or billable professional services
  • Demonstrated success translating strategic vision into operational reality, including technology-enabled business transformation programs / solutions (cloud migration, digital modernization, systems integration, process redesign, change management etc.)
  • Strong background in multi-dimensional client relationship building and executive engagement at C-suite level
  • Expertise in business case development, ROI modeling, and strong analytical skills
  • Financial accountability experience with P&L Management a plus
  • Sales and pursuit management experience in managed services, infrastructure & data center solutions, and professional services
  • Exceptional communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation) with ability to influence at all organizational levels
  • Track record of building a brand, IP and thought leadership (published works, speaking engagements, recognized expertise)
  • Familiarity with hybrid IT environments, mainframe/midrange modernization, or cloud transformations
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with creative problem-solving abilities

Bonus Qualifications

  • Master's degree or MBA
  • Relevant professional certifications (PMP, ITIL, Agile/SAFe, TOGAF etc.)
  • Experience in consulting and/or delivery for financial services, government, or enterprise clients
  • Experience in both pre-sales and post-sales consulting delivery models

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Days Off
  • Three health plan options
  • 401k with company match
  • Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts
  • Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement
  • Paid childbearing and paternal leave
  • Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Wellness program
  • Flexible work schedule

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $178,000 to $242,000 annually based on a full-time schedule. Please note that placement in the range may vary based on numerous factors including but not limited to skills, experience, internal equity, and business needs. In addition to base salary, other compensation programs, depending on eligibility, include an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, and an equity grant under our Associate Equity Appreciation Program.

Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Software Development Test Engineer (SDET), DevOps to design and automate testing for the infrastructure, deployment pipelines and cloud environments that support Keeper’s products. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help ensure the reliability, security and compliance of the infrastructure and automation that power Keeper’s cloud services.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

As a Senior SDET focused on DevOps and infrastructure, you will build automated test frameworks and validation workflows for AWS environments, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments. This is not a traditional manual QA role. You will apply software engineering and automation practices to verify that infrastructure changes are functional, secure, repeatable and compliant before they reach production. You will work closely with DevOps, Platform Engineering, Security and Compliance teams to test infrastructure changes, identify configuration and deployment defects, improve release confidence and strengthen automated validation across Keeper’s cloud environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain automated test frameworks for AWS infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code and deployment workflows
  • Validate infrastructure changes across VPCs, subnets, routing, NAT gateways, IAM, security groups, load balancers and related AWS services
  • Develop automated tests for Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible or similar infrastructure-as-code implementations
  • Build validation into CI/CD pipelines to identify infrastructure, configuration and deployment issues before production release
  • Test containerized and Kubernetes-based environments for functionality, resilience, configuration and security
  • Validate infrastructure hardening and security controls against applicable STIG, CIS and compliance requirements
  • Develop automated integration, regression, smoke, performance and failure-recovery tests for platform and infrastructure changes
  • Verify that Keeper applications and services continue to operate correctly as underlying infrastructure and deployment configurations change
  • Analyze logs, metrics and telemetry to troubleshoot failures and produce clear, reproducible defect reports
  • Partner with DevOps and Platform engineers to identify test gaps, improve infrastructure testability and automate repetitive validation workflows
  • Support audit readiness and compliance validation by producing repeatable test results and technical evidence
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to improve test development, debugging, root-cause analysis, documentation and workflow efficiency

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as an SDET, Software Engineer in Test, Infrastructure Test Engineer or similarly automation-focused engineering role
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure and networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, NAT gateways, security groups and IAM
  • Strong experience testing or validating infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible or similar technologies
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, Go or another language used for test automation and infrastructure validation
  • Experience building automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar platforms
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure testing, configuration validation, integration testing and failure-recovery scenarios
  • Experience troubleshooting cloud and infrastructure issues using logs, metrics and observability platforms such as Datadog
  • Familiarity with security hardening and compliance requirements such as CIS benchmarks, DISA STIGs, FedRAMP, SOC 2 or ISO 27001
  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and automated software delivery practices
  • Ability to work closely with DevOps, Platform Engineering, Security and Compliance teams to diagnose complex technical issues
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to improve test automation, debugging, technical analysis and documentation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience validating infrastructure in FedRAMP High, DoD, IL5 or similarly regulated cloud environments
  • Experience with automated infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest, pytest or similar tools
  • Experience testing Kubernetes infrastructure, container security or deployment resilience
  • Familiarity with vulnerability scanning, compliance drift detection or SIEM integrations
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government
  • Familiarity with secrets management, IAM, PAM or zero-trust security architectures

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
  • References (with your consent, before final offer)
  • Public professional profiles
  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)
  • Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

  • HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration

*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

  • Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
  • Background verification vendors (post offer)
  • Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
  • Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

  • You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)
  • You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Withdraw consent (where applicable)
  • Request data portability
  • Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

10. Contact - Candidates can send privacy questions to:

raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Infrastructure Security Engineering - DGX Cloud
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA DGX Cloudis the AI supercomputing-as-a-service substrate designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial-scale breakthroughs.
raw.description:
NVIDIA DGX Cloudis the AI supercomputing-as-a-service substrate designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial-scale breakthroughs. As an Engineering Manager within our Infrastructure Security Engineering organization, you will enable the engineers who secure a GPU fleet numbering in the hundreds of thousands. Your team does not write reports about risk. It engineers whole classes of risk out of existence, and delivers the result as paved roads the rest of DGX Cloud will happily take.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Grow the Team:Manage, coach, and develop a distributed team of senior security and infrastructure engineers. You own hiring, growth, and performance, and you build a bench deep enough that our capability never rests on one person. Heroics signal a system that needs fixing, so you protect sustainable pace.

  • Set Technical Direction:Partner with your engineers on the roadmap for our security control plane, our foundational security services, and the path toward autonomous security operations. Leadership owns the mission and the strategy; the team owns the execution.

  • Deliver Outcomes, Not Tickets:Run a lightweight planning rhythm where the team commits to a result and the reason it matters, then reflects openly on what to change next. We are measured by the risks we eliminate, not the tickets we close.

  • Assemble Teams Around the Work:Staff each effort with the smallest group who can deliver it, and a clear owner accountable for landing it. Teams form around the work and dissolve when it's done. Make that motion fast, fair, and a real growth opportunity.

  • Raise the Engineering Bar:Hold a high standard for what "done" means: tested code, observability, operational readiness, and documentation someone who didn't build the system can operate from. AI-assisted work ships with real human ownership behind it.

  • Communicate Risk Upward:Translate a complex, fast-moving risk picture into something executives can act on. Declare the unknowns honestly, turn risk assessment into measurable themes, and make trade-offs legible to the people funding them.

  • Multi-Functional Collaboration:Build the partnerships that make the work land. We operate horizontally across vertically organized teams, with influence rather than authority. Your credibility with DGX Cloud platform, SRE, networking, and broader NVIDIA security partners is a delivery mechanism, not a nicety.

What We Need to See:

We are looking for high-caliber engineering leaders with deep spikes of expertise in a few of these areas and the intellectual curiosity to dive into the rest. If your experience aligns with the core of this role—building and growing teams that engineer risk out of existence—and you can show us how, we want to hear from you!

  • Engineering Management:Experience (typically 7+ years) managing engineers, within a broader career (typically 14+ years) across software engineering, SRE, infrastructure, or security. You have grown people, not only shipped projects.

  • Technical Credibility:Enough hands-on depth in infrastructure, distributed systems, or security engineering to earn the trust of senior engineers. You can review a design honestly and recognize when an estimate doesn't add up. You don't need to be the best engineer in the room; you need to build the room.

  • Hiring and Developing Talent:A history of attracting, hiring, and growing excellent engineers, including people far more expert than you in their domain. You build interview and calibration practices that make hiring repeatable and fair.

  • Delivery Under Ambiguity:You can take a high-stakes, loosely defined mandate and turn it into sequenced, measurable delivery. You are comfortable proving a model on a few systems first, then using that success to expand.

  • Cloud-Native and Security Fluency:Working understanding of cloud-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), identity and access, policy enforcement, and vulnerability management—enough to build it and ask the questions that matter.

  • Influence Without Authority:Experience delivering through partner teams you do not own, in environments where relationships, not org charts, determine whether the work ships.

  • Foundation:Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • HPC/AI Infrastructure:Experience running teams that secure or operate high-performance computing environments, large GPU fleets, or multi-tenant platforms at cloud scale.

  • Security as an Internal Product:You have delivered security or infrastructure capabilities with real adoption metrics, where teams took the paved road because it was the easiest path.

  • Building a Function from Scratch:Experience standing up a team, a practice, or an engineering culture where none existed—charter, agreements, rituals, and all.

  • Scaling Without Dilution:A history of growing a team quickly while the bar went up rather than down.How have you scaled a team and raised the standard at the same time?

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 245,000 CAD - 295,000 CAD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 26, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform that manages your entire infrastructure lifecycle — provisioning, configuration and governance. Spacelift integrates with all your infrastructure tooling (e.g. Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible) to provide a single integrated workflow so you can deliver secure, cost-effective, and resilient infrastructure, fast.

By automating deployment and configuration, providing developer self-service, golden paths with guardrails, and an OPA policy engine, Spacelift empowers businesses to accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control and governance over their infrastructure. Spacelift offers unrivalled support, no-nonsense pricing, and a range of deployment models to fit your specific needs.

Spacelift was founded in 2020 by long-time DevOps practitioner Marcin Wyszynski and successful entrepreneur Pawel Hytry and has raised $82.3M in funding over four rounds from top venture capital firms, including Insight Partners, Blossom Capital, Hoxton Ventures, Inovo Venture partners and Five Elms Capital.

Spacelift is building the infrastructure platform that engineering teams actually want to use. We're growing fast, and the partner channel is a core part of how we scale. We're looking for someone to own it.

The role

You'll build Spacelift's reseller partner program from the ground up, starting with two high-priority partners: Ahead and Presidio. This isn't a "manage the existing program" job. You'll define how we work with resellers, what good looks like, and how we grow through them.

What you'll do

  • Design and launch Spacelift's partner reseller program, including deal registration, incentive structures, enablement resources, and co-sell motions

  • Own the Ahead and Presidio relationships end-to-end, from initial onboarding through first revenue and beyond

  • Enable partner sales teams to position and sell Spacelift confidently, building training materials, battlecards, and demo resources they'll actually use

  • Work closely with Spacelift's direct sales team to align on pipeline, territory, and rules of engagement

  • Build the reporting and tracking infrastructure to measure partner-sourced pipeline, revenue, and engagement

  • Identify and prioritise the next wave of reseller partners as the program matures

What we're looking for

  • 3 or more years in partner management, channel sales, or alliances at a B2B software company

  • Direct experience working with Ahead, Presidio, or similar national solution providers

  • A track record of building programs, not just inheriting them

  • Enough technical fluency to understand what Spacelift does and why it matters to a platform engineering team

  • Strong cross-functional instincts: you'll work with sales, marketing, and product regularly

  • Someone who moves fast, operates independently, and figures things out without needing a playbook handed to them

Why Spacelift?

  • Innovative Culture: Join a team shaping cloud infrastructure management’s future.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be a key player in driving Spacelift’s business and AWS partnership to new heights.

  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible work environment, with remote-first options and competitive compensation packages.

  • Collaborative Team: Work with passionate, talented people committed to driving success for our customers and partners.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Medical, dental and vision plans for employees and any dependents

  • 401k Pension Plan

  • 26 days of paid time off annually + local bank holidays

  • Flexible working hours and a healthy 40-hour workweek

  • Work from anywhere! We are a full-remote company

  • Learning & education budget

  • Company offsites

  • Work from anywhere in the US. We are a full-remote company

  • Work in an international, diverse, dynamic, and passionate team with a friendly and supportive company culture

Our values

  • We build for CUSTOMERS

  • We RESPECT each other

This is a new-business-focused role for an experienced sales professional who can engage C-suite decision-makers, navigate multiple stakeholders and lead enterprise opportunities from initial prospecting through to contract close.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, you will develop strategic relationships with major organisations, understand their operational and safety challenges, and demonstrate how Forwood’s solutions can deliver meaningful business value.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Build and manage a targeted pipeline of major enterprise prospects within your assigned market or vertical.
  • Develop account strategies and weekly activity plans focused on securing new business from priority organisations.
  • Lead complex SaaS sales cycles averaging nine months or longer and involving multiple stakeholders across different departments.
  • Engage confidently with C-suite executives and senior operational, safety, technology and commercial leaders.
  • Identify customer needs through strong discovery and qualification, then develop tailored proposals and presentations.
  • Clearly communicate Forwood’s value proposition and connect our solutions to customers’ strategic and operational objectives.
  • Partner closely with BDRs to create opportunities and maintain a consistent prospecting cadence.
  • Use LinkedIn and other channels to identify, engage and develop relationships with prospective customers.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, activity and forecast information within the CRM.
  • Report on sales performance, pipeline progression, market developments and potential risks.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product and Customer Success to support sales initiatives, product launches and customer solutions.
  • Meet or exceed agreed revenue targets while following Forwood’s sales processes and operating standards.

What you’ll bring

  • At least four years’ experience in Sales Executive or Account Executive roles, selling complex B2B SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations.
  • A strong track record of new-logo acquisition and independently creating new business opportunities.
  • Demonstrated success managing annual quotas of US$1 million or more.
  • Experience closing SaaS deals with an average value above US$150,000.
  • Experience managing sales cycles of nine months or longer.
  • The ability to clearly discuss your quota and sales results from the past four to five years.

  • Strong C-suite communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience navigating procurement, commercial negotiations and complex decision-making processes involving multiple stakeholders.

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of strategic enterprise opportunities and represent solutions designed to create meaningful improvements in workplace safety. You will join a collaborative, high-performing team and work directly with senior customer stakeholders to solve complex business challenges.

If you are a disciplined enterprise SaaS seller who thrives on winning new business, influencing executive decision-makers and closing complex, high-value deals, we would like to hear from you.

Job Description:

This role is a REMOTE job, but does require you to currently live within 90 miles of the Greater Phoenix, AZ area.

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

The Role

As a Retirement Planner within Fidelity’s Tax-Exempt Market Planning & Advice (TEMPA) team, you will educate and support workplace retirement plan participants by increasing awareness of retirement readiness and helping individuals take meaningful steps toward achieving their long-term financial goals. This role is responsible for guiding participants through their employer-sponsored retirement plans, including educating them on plan benefits, employer matching contributions, and investment strategies, while helping them make informed decisions about their retirement savings. The Retirement Planner conducts needs-based conversations to identify participant goals, uncover opportunities for retirement asset consolidation, and identify appropriate solutions that support overall retirement objectives. By providing personalized guidance and collaborating with other members of the TEMPA team when more complex planning needs arise, you will play a critical role in enhancing participant outcomes, building customer loyalty, and strengthening long-term relationships with Fidelity.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in investment sales, financial planning, or a related advisory role
  • FINRA Series 7 and 66 licenses preferred; Series 7 and 63 required, with the ability to obtain the Series 65 or 66 within 90 days of hire
  • Strong understanding of financial markets, economic conditions, and industry trends
  • Excellent consultative, influencing, and communication skills with the ability to build trust and drive client engagement
  • Demonstrated initiative and a proactive approach to identifying client needs and opportunities
  • Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment
  • Openness to coaching, performance feedback, and adapting to evolving business needs and priorities
  • Ability to effectively leverage planning tools and resources to help participants assess and improve their retirement readiness
  • Proven ability to conduct needs-based conversations, identify appropriate solutions, and support asset acquisition, retention, and growth
  • Strong ability to articulate Fidelity's approach and vision to provide general investment education to clients

The Team

The Tax-Exempt Market Planning & Advice (TEMPA) organization exists to help employees in our tax-exempt workplace communities. Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner for plan sponsors and participants, providing education and financial planning and advice for our 403b and 457 plan participants. Our value is delivered to over one million plan participants every year, encouraging them to reach their financial goals and bringing the broader Fidelity Advantage to life.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

Certifications:

Series 07 - FINRA, Series 66 - FINRA

Category:

Sales

Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.
