About Wunderkind:Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue. Founded in 2010, Our goal is to scale a brand’s ability to create and grow customer relationships through websites, email, text, and ads. We believe individuals should have the freedom to choose the kind of internet they want. An internet that fosters genuine relationships with brands. An internet that treats humans like real people instead of “web traffic.” We also believe in empowering brands to treat their customers as individuals, satisfying their unique needs with tailored experiences and thoughtful communication. By expertly personalizing, automating, and scaling beautiful one-to-one experiences, Wunderkind helps brands acquire new customers at scale and keep them loyal for life.

About the Role:

Wunderkind is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and high-impact leader to serve as the Director, Pipeline. This pivotal role has full ownership over the US Pipeline strategy and is responsible for driving the growth, execution, and efficiency of our North American outbound demand generation engine across our Business Development Associate (BDA) and Concierge teams.

As a key partner to the executive leadership team, you will manage, scale, and mentor a growing department of 10 professionals—including BDAs, Senior BDAs, and a dedicated Concierge Manager. This position requires a builder's mindset: someone who can blend rigorous operational discipline with forward-thinking AI-driven workflows to shift the organization from vanity metrics to high-value pipeline generation.

  • Title: Director, Pipeline Development
  • Location: USA, Remote
  • Reporting Line: Reports directly to the CEO / Executive Team (interim) pending the appointment of the AMER Commercial Lead
  • Management Level: People Leader (Managing 10 direct reports)

Role Responsibilities

1. Strategic Pipeline & US Market Ownership

  • Define and execute the end-to-end US Pipeline strategy, optimizing performance across distinct account tiers to drive predictable revenue streams.
  • Oversee the strategic allocation and redistribution of the Total Addressable Market (TAM) among BDAs and Senior BDAs, ensuring optimal pairing with target segments.
  • Manage and scale the newly re-architected H2 compensation and variable quota plans, aligning individual targets closely with Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs) and Gross Revenue targets.

2. Team Leadership & Operational Management

  • Directly lead and develop a 10-person function consisting of Business Development Associates (BDAs), Senior BDAs, a Pipeline Creation Manager, and a Concierge Manager.
  • Standardize a rigorous recruitment, interviewing, and onboarding workflow to quickly fill capacity vacancies, leaning heavily into behavioral competencies and structured training playbooks.
  • Structure a scalable "pod leader" architecture (leveraging player-coaches) to manage collective team output, performance-based tracking, and career leveling progression.

3. Concierge & Partner Sourcing Strategy

  • Architect and oversee the Concierge function, focusing specialized headcount on high-cost, high-return Tier 1 and Tier 2 strategic accounts to justify boardroom investment.
  • Establish performance benchmarks for the partner program, holding the team accountable to a strict partner-acquisition metric (e.g., securing a minimum of one high-value partner per quarter).
  • Revitalize historical external advisor relationships (EIRs) and actively manage powerhouse partner networks to streamline warm introductions and boost lead-to-close conversion rates.

4. Cross-Functional Synergy & Technical Innovation

  • Bridge the collaboration gap between the Pipeline organization and the broader New Business (BD) sales teams to ensure a seamless, high-velocity handoff from SQL/SAO stages to Closed-Won revenue.
  • Champion the adoption of advanced AI-assisted workflows (leveraging LLMs and predictive research agents) to execute highly tailored, personalized outreach at scale rather than relying on standard "pipe-gen theater" volume metrics.
  • Partner closely with Finance and RevOps to audit commercial decision-making, manage fixed On-Target Earnings (OTE) budgets, and validate pipeline health against the company’s $20M+ growth targets.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 8+ years of relevant experience in sales development, pipeline operations, or commercial business development management within a fast-growing B2B SaaS or MarTech ecosystem.
  • Strategic Acumen: Deep familiarity with advanced incentive compensation modeling, commercial budgeting, and designing variable sales plans alongside Finance and RevOps partners.
  • Tech Stack Mastery: Advanced knowledge of CRM and sales acceleration infrastructure (Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and project management platforms)
  • AI & Modern Automation Workflows: Practical experience integrating generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) into day-to-day data research, personalization, and prospecting sequences.
  • Commercial Reality & Grit: A strong executive presence capable of running structured professional evaluations, handling strict fiscal constraints without compromising team morale, and steering an organization through organizational changes and rapid scaling phases.

The base salary range for this role is $120,000.00 to $140,000.00, not including variable incentives. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. This may vary depending on living location and market rate.

raw.excerpt: About CleerlyWe’re Cleerly – a healthcare company that’s revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked.
raw.description:
About Cleerly

We’re Cleerly – a healthcare company that’s revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world’s leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on-site in a location.

Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value-based, AI-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly’s solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world’s largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person’s risk of heart attacks.

At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description.

While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time.
Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.

About the Opportunity

Cleerly is seeking a highly accomplished Director, Corporate Accounts to lead enterprise-level commercial engagement
with the largest Integrated Delivery Networks, health systems, and hospital organizations in the United States. This is a
senior national role responsible for opening, developing, contracting, and expanding strategic IDN relationships that can

materially accelerate Cleerly's growth.

The Director, Corporate Accounts will report directly to the Chief Commercial Officer and will be responsible for building
executive-level relationships across C-suite leadership, cardiovascular and imaging service line leaders, supply chain,
contracting, and other key enterprise stakeholders. This individual will be expected to operate as a boardroom-level
healthcare commercial leader who can clearly articulate Cleerly's clinical, economic, operational, and strategic value to
large, complex health systems.
This role is not a traditional hospital sales position. The Director, Corporate Accounts will focus on national IDN strategy,
enterprise contracting, committed-volume agreements, and strategic 'hunting license' agreements that create
opportunities for Cleerly's local hospital sales teams to drive site-level adoption and pull-through.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a national corporate account strategy targeting the largest and most strategically important IDNs and hospital systems in the United States.
  • Identify, open, and advance executive-level relationships with C-suite leaders, cardiovascular and imaging service line executives, supply chain, contracting, finance, and other key decision-makers within priority IDNs.
  • Lead the full enterprise sales process from initial access and strategic discovery through value proposition development, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close.
  • Secure new national IDN and hospital system agreements that drive annual recurring revenue, committed CCTA volume, total contract value, and long-term strategic account growth.
  • Expand existing hospital system and IDN relationships by identifying additional sites, service lines, use cases, products, and enterprise-level opportunities.
  • Drive enterprise subscription and committed-volume agreements wherever possible, while also structuring strategic per-click or 'hunting license' agreements when appropriate to create broader access for local hospital sales teams.
  • Partner closely with local hospital sales representatives to create opportunities, open doors, and enable local pull-through at individual hospitals and sites within contracted IDNs.
  • Partner with Client Success Managers, Sales Leadership, Implementation, Marketing, Market Access, Sales Operations, Legal, and other internal stakeholders to ensure successful launch, adoption, utilization, QBRs, and account expansion after enterprise contracts are signed.
  • Navigate complex IDN buying processes, including value analysis committees, supply chain, contracting, legal, IT/security review, market access discussions, and executive approval processes.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of national IDN opportunities with clear account plans, stakeholder maps, next steps, revenue potential, committed CCTA volume, contract value, and forecast accuracy.
  • Develop strategic account plans for each priority IDN, including executive sponsors, clinical champions, financial buyers, contracting pathway, competitive dynamics, current CCTA volume, expansion potential, and local pull-through opportunities.
  • Represent Cleerly externally as a senior commercial leader capable of engaging credibly with health system executives on cardiovascular care transformation, imaging strategy, AI adoption, value-based care, patient access, and enterprise growth.

Performance Measures

  • New contracted IDNs and hospital systems.
  • Annual recurring revenue generated from national IDN agreements.
  • Committed CCTA volume secured through enterprise agreements.
  • Total contract value closed.
  • Expansion revenue within existing IDN and hospital system accounts.
  • Number and quality of local hospital opportunities created for field sales teams.
  • Strategic account penetration across executive, clinical, operational, and contracting stakeholders.
  • Forecast accuracy, pipeline quality, and progression of priority IDN opportunities.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of enterprise healthcare sales, corporate account management, strategic account leadership, or national account sales experience.
  • Demonstrated success selling into large IDNs, hospital systems, academic medical centers, or complex healthcare enterprises.
  • Strong existing relationships with senior leaders and decision-makers at the national IDN level.
  • Proven experience opening and closing large, complex healthcare enterprise agreements, ideally in the $500K to $5M+ contract value range.
  • Experience selling medtech, healthcare AI, imaging, diagnostics, SaaS, cardiology, radiology, digital health, or other clinically oriented enterprise solutions.
  • Deep understanding of how large health systems evaluate, purchase, contract, implement, and scale new clinical technologies.
  • Experience navigating IDN stakeholders including C-suite executives, service line leaders, supply chain, contracting, legal, finance, IT/security, clinical champions, and value analysis committees.
  • Ability to sell across clinical, economic, workflow, strategic, and operational value drivers.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to build enterprise-level business cases, ROI models, and executive presentations.
  • Track record of building strategic account plans, managing complex deal cycles, and accurately forecasting large enterprise opportunities.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with field sales, client success, Sales Leadership, implementation, marketing, Market Access, legal, and Sales Operations teams.
  • Executive presence, strong communication skills, and credibility in boardroom-level health system discussions.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to succeed in the role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling cardiovascular, radiology, imaging, AI-enabled clinical decision support, or advanced diagnostic solutions.
  • Experience with CCTA, coronary artery disease, cardiovascular service line strategy, population health, or value-based care.
  • Prior success creating national agreements that enabled local field sales teams to drive site-level adoption and pull-through.
  • Experience in a high-growth healthcare technology company.
  • Familiarity with market access, clinical workflow integration, and hospital implementation processes.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior enterprise healthcare commercial leader with deep IDN relationships, strong executive presence, and a proven ability to close large, complex health system agreements. This person knows how to create access at the national level, build strategic alignment with senior decision-makers, navigate complex contracting processes, and structure agreements that create meaningful revenue growth.

This individual must be comfortable operating independently, building strategy from the ground up, and partnering with local hospital sales teams to convert national access into local adoption. They should be equally capable of speaking with a CEO, CFO, Chief Medical Officer, cardiovascular service line leader, radiology leader, supply chain executive, or contracting team.

Most importantly, this person must understand that Cleerly's opportunity with large IDNs requires more than selling a product. It requires positioning Cleerly as a strategic partner that can help health systems transform how they identify, evaluate, and manage coronary artery disease.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is aligned to market benchmarks and determined by experience, skills, and internal equity.

This role is eligible for annual On Target Commission, resulting in the following base salary and Total Target Compensation (TTC) ranges:

  • Base Salary: $175,000 - $225,000
  • Commission: $125,000
  • TTC: $300,000 - $350,000

*Total Target Compensation (TTC): Total Cash Compensation (including base pay, variable pay, commission, bonuses, etc.) Additionally, stock options, paid benefits, and employee perks are part of your total rewards.

Working at Cleerly takes HEART. Discover our Core Values:

  • H: Humility- be a servant leader
  • E: Excellence- deliver world-changing results
  • A: Accountability- do what you say; expect the same from others
  • R: Remarkable- inspire & innovate with impact
  • T: Teamwork- together we win

Don’t meet 100 percent of the qualifications? Apply anyway and help us diversify our candidate pool and workforce. We value experience, whether gained formally or informally on the job or through other experiences. Job duties, activities and responsibilities are subject to change by our company.

OUR COMPANY IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.

The Operations Lead is a key leadership role within our Structured Teams (Managed Services) division, responsible for driving operational excellence, scalability, and strategic execution across legal operations service delivery. This individual serves as a central facilitator among multiple cross-functional teams and workstreams, ensuring alignment, accountability, and efficient execution of operational priorities.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in eDiscovery and legal operations, a passion for people leadership, and a proven ability to identify and implement process improvements that enhance performance, reporting, and client outcomes. Working closely with department leadership, the Operations Lead will help shape and execute the strategic vision for the department while developing and mentoring a team of Operations Analysts.

Responsibilities

    • Facilitate collaboration across cross-functional teams to ensure operational alignment and successful execution of priorities.
    • Drive efficiency, standardization, and scalability across operational workstreams.
    • Develop and enhance metrics, dashboards, and reporting to support data-driven decision-making.
    • Identify, prioritize, and execute strategic initiatives in partnership with department leadership.
    • Lead process improvement efforts to improve performance, quality, and operational effectiveness.
    • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of Operations Analysts.
    • Monitor operational performance and recommend solutions to address risks and opportunities.
    • Lead day-to-day operational initiatives across the Managed Services organization to ensure efficient, consistent, and scalable service delivery.
    • Act as a facilitator and coordinator across multiple cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and workstreams.
    • Identify operational bottlenecks and drive process improvements that enhance productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction.
    • Establish and maintain operational best practices, standards, and governance processes.
    • Develop and manage operational reporting frameworks with a strong emphasis on metrics, analytics, and data-driven decision making.
    • Create and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and performance reporting mechanisms to measure operational effectiveness.
    • Analyze trends and provide actionable insights to leadership regarding resource utilization, service delivery performance, and operational health.
    • Promote a collaborative, high-performing team culture focused on accountability and continuous improvement.
    • Build strong working relationships with business leaders, legal operations professionals, eDiscovery teams, technology partners, and other key stakeholders.
    • Serve as a trusted operational advisor and escalation point for complex issues and initiatives.
    Facilitate communication and alignment across departments to ensure successful execution of organizational goals

Qualifications

  • Required

    • Significant experience in legal operations and eDiscovery environments.
    • Strong understanding of eDiscovery workflows, technologies, and service delivery models.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
    • Experience leading operational improvement and cross-functional initiatives.
    • Proven ability to develop and leverage metrics and reporting to drive business outcomes.
    • Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
    • Demonstrated interest and aptitude for people management and team development.

    Preferred

    • Experience in a managed services organization.
    • Proficiency with Smartsheet or similar project management and workflow tools.

    The successful candidate is a strategic thinker who can seamlessly balance long-term vision with day-to-day execution. They are highly collaborative, naturally skilled at bringing diverse teams together, and motivated by creating scalable solutions that improve operational effectiveness. They possess strong eDiscovery expertise, a data-driven mindset, and a genuine passion for developing people while helping shape the future of a growing Managed Services organization.

raw.excerpt: As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless!
raw.description:
As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Director, General Liability Pricing Analytics

The Role

In this position, you will work at the intersection of predictive analytics, actuarial thinking, and pricing strategy. You will partner closely with teammates and business partners to build, enhance, and refine models that support general liability insurance pricing. You will also have the opportunity to work across a variety of projects, expand your technical toolkit, and deepen your understanding of how modeling drives real business outcomes.

As Director, General Liability Pricing Analytics, you will serve as the senior technical leader for General Liability pricing data science and price modeling. You will lead the development, enhancement and implementation of pricing models and data science solutions that support profitable growth, competitive market position and sound underwriting decisions.

This is a hands-on people leadership role with direct reports. You will combine deep expertise in actuarial, statistical and predictive modeling with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for Actuaries, Underwriting, Product, Claims, Finance and senior business leaders. You will guide and develop analytical professionals, including direct reports, lead complex work across functions and help establish consistent standards for model quality, documentation, validation and use.

Key Responsibilities

Technical and Model Leadership

  • Set technical direction for General Liability pricing strategy, segmentation, rating analysis, portfolio insights and model delivery.

  • Lead the research, development, implementation and monitoring of advanced statistical, actuarial, predictive and risk models.

  • Explore and pilot emerging AI tools and advanced statistical methods to improve General Liability price modeling and analytical workflows, while maintaining appropriate standards for governance, validation, explainability and production readiness.

  • Evaluate data, assumptions, methodologies and model outputs; identify limitations or unreasonable results and recommend corrective actions.

  • Own model governance standards covering validation, documentation, reproducibility, implementation readiness and business continuity.

Business Partnership and Decision Support

  • Translate underwriting and business needs into clear analytical questions, recommendations and delivery plans.

  • Partner with Actuaries, Underwriting, Product, Claims, Finance, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to ensure analytical solutions are understood and applied effectively.

  • Convert complex findings into concise recommendations and decision materials for technical, non-technical and senior leadership audiences.

  • Advise on products, data needs, rating approaches, implementation implications and opportunities to improve profitability and underwriting decisions.

Delivery and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead complex projects, cross-functional reviews and working sessions that align stakeholders around priorities, tradeoffs and actions.

  • Manage scope, timelines, resources and delivery quality across assigned work.

  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, analytical processes, technology enablement and model delivery practices.

  • Represent Nationwide in governance forums and with auditors, regulators, vendors or industry groups, as appropriate.

Talent and Team Leadership

  • Coach and develop analytical talent through technical guidance, peer review, training, career development and feedback.

  • Lead the day-to-day people management of direct reports, including hiring, performance management, talent planning, resource alignment and career development.

  • Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Typically, seven or more years of experience in actuarial, statistical, predictive modeling, risk analytics, pricing analytics or a related quantitative discipline.

  • Experience leading complex projects, setting analytical direction and delivering results across business functions.

  • Graduate or PhD degree in actuarial science, statistics, mathematics, data science, economics, finance, engineering or a related quantitative field; graduate study preferred.

Technical Expertise

  • Experience developing, validating, implementing or monitoring complex models used to support business decisions.

  • Strong understanding of statistical inference, predictive modeling, model diagnostics, data quality, assumptions and model limitations.

  • Working knowledge of commercial property and casualty insurance; General Liability pricing, underwriting or portfolio experience strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency in Python and GitHub-based version control, along with experience using cloud-based analytics, model development, or deployment platforms such as Databricks, SageMaker, or comparable tools.

  • Demonstrated experience taking a model from development through production deployment, testing, documentation, monitoring, and post-deployment validation.

Leadership and Professional Effectiveness

  • Sound judgment in ambiguous business situations, with the ability to develop practical, well-supported recommendations.

  • Ability to communicate sophisticated technical concepts in clear business language and influence technical and non-technical partners.

  • Demonstrated commitment to Nationwide Values and Guiding Behaviors.

Preferred Qualifications

Insurance and Actuarial Depth

  • Associate or Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society, or meaningful progress toward an actuarial designation.

  • Experience with commercial insurance pricing, loss-cost analysis, frequency and severity modeling, segmentation, indication analysis, rate implementation or portfolio monitoring.

Advanced Modeling and Governance

  • Experience applying machine learning, generalized linear models, credibility methods, stochastic techniques or other advanced quantitative methods to insurance problems.

  • Experience with model governance, peer review, independent validation, regulatory support or audit response.

Business Impact and People Leadership

  • Experience translating model output into underwriting actions, pricing recommendations and measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience directly managing and developing actuaries, data scientists, analytic scientists or pricing professionals.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be a technically credible, business-oriented leader who:

  • Brings curiosity, rigor and sound judgment to complex pricing and risk questions.

  • Connects analytical work to underwriting decisions, customer outcomes, profitability and enterprise strategy.

  • Creates clarity when objectives, data or stakeholder perspectives are competing or incomplete.

  • Raises the quality of analytical work through thoughtful challenge, peer review and disciplined documentation.

  • Develops people while maintaining high standards for accountability, collaboration and delivery.

  • Builds durable partnerships and communicates with confidence at all levels of the organization.

Job Conditions

This role can be staffed fully remote.

Job Description Summary

Do you have the desire to play a critical role in driving data-based business outcomes? At Nationwide, our Analytic Scientists are responsible for modeling complex problems, discovering insights and identifying business opportunities using scientific research methods, statistics, machine learning, and data visualization techniques. They participate in all phases of the analytic lifecycle, from research design, data collection and data processing to model building, deployment, and presentation of results. We value a dedication to lifelong learning and strong quantitative judgment. If you are a methodological generalist who is adept at applying your technical skill set to a wide range of business applications, we want to know more about you!

As a Director, you’ll lead a team of Analytic Scientists and work directly with business partners to define project scope and build solutions. We’ll count on you to structure and lead large, complex analyses across one or more business areas and effectively synthesize analytic results to improve business outcomes. You’ll build lasting business relationships across and help business leaders navigate complex, competing objectives. You’ll be a subject matter authority, in both analytical and business applications, and will communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences. Your proficiency with advanced statistical and machine learning techniques will help you direct the application of these techniques to solve complex problems.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads a team that works on a wide array of statistical and machine learning projects across the enterprise.

  • Collaborates with business partners to build consensus around problems of broad scope and business impact. Guides the research, analysis, implementation and monitoring of modeling methodology to solve those problems.

  • Upholds a high standard for methodological rigor, sound statistical inference and robust model validation.

  • Plans and manages the execution of analytic work including defining project scope, schedule, resource requirements and delivery timelines.

  • Collaborates with multiple departments or business functions to accomplish management goals, objectives and tasks.

  • Communicates technical work to leadership.

  • Demonstrates knowledge of a wide array of business practices and business knowledge. Applies knowledge to direct projects that provide creative solutions to complex business problems.

  • Directs associate management, including performance management, salary planning and administration, training and development, workflow and organizational planning, hiring and placement, and disciplinary actions.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Associate Vice President, Vice President. Manages a team of 4 or more associates responsible for creating a high-performance, business-focused team. Ensures that team members at all levels are supported with career development, succession planning, performance management, etc.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Preferred undergraduate or graduate studies in statistics, engineering, math, quantitative social science fields, or related areas. Experience building and deploying machine learning and/or statistical models or executing quantitative research studies may be considered in lieu of formal education.

Experience: Typically, 10 or more years of related work experience in a relevant field.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills:
Quantitative judgment: Demonstrated knowledge of building and deploying machine learning and/or statistical models.

Research methods: Knowledge of multiple quantitative research and analysis approaches and their tradeoffs.

Strong project management skills and the ability to handle multiple large projects simultaneously.

Advanced written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate technical concepts to all levels of leaders and associates.

Seeks and objectively considers input from appropriate sources. Considers implications of actions on other areas, people, and processes when making decisions.

Drives decisions, projects, and processes without formal authority. Works directly with a variety of people to create broad acceptance for proposed innovations and changes.

Implements changes which improve business processes. Anticipates and responds to changing situations, needs and expectations.

Able to handle large and complex engagements focused on broader business activities.

Ability to lead key relationships and act independently.

Programming ability: Python, R, SQL, or any other transferrable language (MATLAB, Java, etc.).

Passion, inquisitiveness, creativity, self-starters and team builders.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the Vice President and HR Vice President.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Exempt (Not Eligible)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment

At Current, Senior Product Designers (Webflow) lead the design and delivery of engaging digital experiences across multiple client engagements. You're equally comfortable conducting UX discovery, designing polished experiences in Figma, and building production-ready websites in Webflow. You own projects from concept through launch, partnering with engineering only when advanced custom development or integrations are required.

What You'll Do

  • Lead UX and visual design across websites and digital experiences for multiple client engagements
  • Partner with strategy, production, engineering, and client stakeholders to define user experience and creative direction
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs in Figma

What You'll Bring

  • 5–7 years of UX/UI, Product, or Digital Design experience, ideally within an agency or consulting environment
  • 2+ years building production-ready websites in Webflow
  • Advanced proficiency with Figma and Webflow
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership from UX strategy through final Webflow implementation
  • Experience building scalable Webflow websites using CMS Collections, Components, and design systems
  • Experience with Client-First methodology, Relume, and Finsweet Attributes
  • Strong understanding of UX, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and information architecture
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS with the ability to partner effectively with engineers
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Lottie, GSAP, or interactive animations
  • Experience integrating Webflow with HubSpot, Memberstack, Airtable, Zapier, Make, or similar platforms
  • Experience using analytics or A/B testing to inform design decisions
  • Familiarity with Jira, Workfront, or similar project management tools
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the U.S., working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

This is a temporary-to-permanent opportunity. The role will begin as a hourly position, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time employee based on business needs and individual performance.

The target hourly compensation range for the temporary portion of this role is $45.00 - $65.00 per hour. If converted to full-time, the target range of base compensation for this role is $100,000 - $125,000 annually. This role is best suited for someone with proven recruiting experience, preferably in AEI or a related professional services environment, who is confident in sourcing, screening, and building strong working relationships across the business.

raw.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

You will shape the visual language of A1's product. In AI applications, visual design must do more than look polished. It must help users understand dynamic content, system behavior, reliability signals, and complex AI-driven workflows.

This role supports HCI by making the interface clearer, more readable, and easier to trust.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design the visual language, design system, and UI components for A1's product across web and mobile.

  • Create visual patterns that help users parse AI-generated content, distinguish system states, and understand confidence and reliability signals.

  • Design for information density and hierarchy in AI interfaces where content is dynamic, variable, and often uncertain.

  • Work with product and UX designers to translate interaction flows into polished, accessible visual designs.

  • Build and maintain a design system that supports speed, consistency, and clarity.

  • Define visual standards for error states, empty states, loading states, task states, and AI-generated output.

  • Contribute visual assets and design specs that engineers can implement accurately.

  • Make AI-heavy interfaces feel clear and structured without overwhelming users.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a visual or UI designer with a portfolio across web or mobile products.

  • Strong skills in typography, color, layout, and visual hierarchy.

  • Proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to design systems.

  • Ability to design for dynamic content where AI output varies in length, format, tone, and reliability.

  • Understanding of accessibility standards and how to design for legibility and contrast.

  • Comfort designing under ambiguity, with evolving product requirements.

  • Experience working closely with product and UX designers in fast-moving teams.

  • Awareness of how visual cues communicate AI system behavior, trust, and confidence.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Customer-Centric Mindset

  • Deep empathy for customers and agents using Five9’s AI products.
  • Experience engaging customers directly to gather insights and validate direction.
  • Ability to translate customer problems into clear technical strategies and roadmaps.
  1. Organizational & Strategic Skills

Vision and Strategy

  • Ability to define and execute the long-range engineering strategy.
  • Strong understanding of the AI competitive landscape; able to guide build-vs-buy decisions and partner evaluations.
  • Experience driving architectural modernization initiatives to scale AI products.

Execution & Delivery

  • Mastery of engineering execution frameworks—OKRs, agile methodologies, metrics-driven management.
  • Ability to balance innovation with reliability, velocity, and long-term maintainability.
  • Skilled in managing large, multi-quarter programs and cross-org dependencies.

Budgeting and Resource Planning

  • Proficiency with capacity planning, headcount allocation, staffing strategy, and forecasting infrastructure costs.
  • Experience negotiating vendor contracts, including AI model providers and cloud services.

Change Management

  • Ability to lead through rapid growth, shifts in technology, and organizational restructuring.
  • Experience merging teams, establishing new engineering sites, and building distributed engineering organizations.

Job description summary

This Director role sits within Data Products and Foundations, under Data Partnerships, Innovation and Products. The role reports to the Executive Director, Innovative Data Offerings and Products and partners closely with DEO (Data Enablement Organization) to execute the strategy set for trusted, reusable, AI-ready data products.

This role owns patient-centric data products across patient journey, SP/ASOC, hub, and access domains, defining the vision, roadmap, prioritization, adoption plan, and value measures needed to improve patient identification, access, treatment initiation, adherence, persistence, and out-comes. The Director will ensure products are defined in innovative ways that go beyond datasets, embedding business meaning, rules, metrics, lineage, metadata, and context so they can be re-used by business users, analytics teams, and AI-enabled solutions.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and lifecycle management for Patient Journey, SP/ASOC, Hub, Access.
  • Define products in innovative ways by embedding business meaning, semantic definitions, reusable measures, standards, metadata, lineage, and clear consumption patterns directly into the product design.
  • Work closely with DEO (Data Enablement Organization) to translate the strategy into executable plans, align on delivery priorities, remove operational barriers, and ensure products are scalable, reliable, and ready for enterprise consumption.
  • Partner across business, analytics, technology, Data Partnerships, Innovation and Products, and Data Products and Foundations teams to prioritize high-value capabilities and reduce duplication.
  • Drive product adoption, stakeholder engagement, product performance management, issue prioritization, and continuous enhancement based on business needs and user feedback.
  • Establish product standards, governance routines, intake processes, service expectations, and value measures that ensure reliability, reuse, compliance, scalability, and business impact.

Experience:

Novartis is seeking an experienced Director to lead product strategy, delivery, adoption, and governance for Payer, HCP, Omnichannel, Engagement. The ideal candidate brings product leadership, cross-functional influence, and the ability to partner with DEO to execute strategy while translating business priorities into trusted, reusable, AI-ready data products.

Essential Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in related field is required; Master of Science and/or MBA strongly preferred
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, technology, data, analytics, or consulting, with a strong focus on data products, data strategy, product management, or analytics enablement.
  • Minimum 5+ years of domain expertise in patient journey data, SP/ASOC data, hub and access data, patient services, market access analytics, commercial analytics, product management, data governance, and AI-ready semantic data products.
  • Proven ability to define product vision, roadmap, prioritization, use cases, adoption plans, value measures, and governance routines in a complex matrixed environment.
  • Strong understanding of semantic data products, business definitions, data quality, metadata, lineage, standards, and AI-ready data consumption patterns.
  • Experience partnering with data enablement, platform, technology, analytics, business, governance, and operations teams to execute strategy and scale data products.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into data product requirements and present complex concepts clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Must understand both data and the relevant business/domain context to bridge technical requirements with business needs, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage ambiguity, and adapt to changing business priorities while maintaining focus on measurable outcomes.

The salary for this position is expected to range between $185,500.00 and $344,500.00 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Job Summary

Belden is seeking a highly skilled and motivated SAP Supply chain Analyst to support S/4 HANA solutions. Ideal candidate is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and enhancing Belden's SAP SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning capabilities. As part of the Application Management Services (AMS) organization, this role leads production support, continuous improvement, and business engagement across Supply chain functions, including Production Planning (PP), Quality Management (QM), and IBP. This role ensures effective supply-demand synchronization, production scheduling, and capacity alignment, while working closely with manufacturing teams to ensure planning outputs are executable.

Responsibilities

Production Support & Service Delivery

  • Provide AMS support for SAP Supply Chain Planning processes i.e ePP/DS, & QM
  • Lead incident resolution, problem management, and root cause analysis for production and shop floor issues.
  • Monitor system performance, interfaces, background jobs, and integrations to ensure operational stability.
  • Drive SLA compliance and support governance across internal teams, offshore resources, and external partners.
  • Ensure continuity of manufacturing operations by prioritizing and resolving business-critical issues.

System Configuration & Integration

  • Support ePP/DS processes, including Production Data Structures (PDS), resources, planning versions, transportation lanes, and scheduling scenarios (e.g., finite scheduling, capacity planning).
  • Support MRP Live processes for real-time material requirements planning, ensuring effective supply-demand alignment and inventory optimization.
  • Planning strategies such as Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order, and Kitting-to-Stock scenarios.
  • Support integration with SAP modules: PP, MM, EWM, SD, QM.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot planning-related interfaces and data flows.
  • Support integration between planning and production execution.
  • Support SAP IBP processes:

Business Partnership & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with planning, manufacturing, and supply chain teams.
  • Improve planning accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Support user training and planning adoption.
  • Drive standardization across planning processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP experience in supply chain or manufacturing.
  • Strong knowledge of ePP/DS configuration, including PDS, resources, planning versions, transportation lanes, and scheduling techniques.
  • Working knowledge in MRP Live, including real-time material planning, exception handling, and integration with production and procurement processes.
  • Experience integrating ePP/DS and MRP Live with SAP modules such as MM, SD, WM, QM, and FICO.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective SAP S/4HANA planning solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with experience working in global delivery teams.
  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing master data (BOMs, routings, work centers, production versions).
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing configuration and integration with MM, EWM, SD, TM, and Finance.
  • Experience supporting production environments within an AMS or support organization.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing incidents, enhancements, releases, and change control processes.

Applicants can expect a base compensation range of $101,400 - $152,100 plus benefits and additional incentives based on the level of the role. This is the reasonable estimate that Belden believes it might pay for this job based on applicable circumstances at the time of posting. Belden may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range as permitted by law, and commensurate with the applicant’s experience, qualifications, and geographical location.

Belden also offers hybrid and remote work practices where feasible and provides employees with benefits that could include health/dental/vision, long term/short term disability, life insurance, HSA/FSA, matching retirement plans, paid vacation, parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, paid leave for volunteer work in your community, training opportunities, professional talent management and succession planning, corporate health well-being initiatives and a work culture which includes commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and sustainability!

Let’s Create Possibilities Together.

Join a global community shaping the future of intelligent connectivity. At Belden, you’ll help push the boundaries of technology and write the next chapter of innovation, creating possibilities for your career, your future, and the world around you.

raw.excerpt: Who we areAbout StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Business Value Consulting team focuses on driving long-term growth and value creation for Stripe's largest and most strategic users. The team quantifies the financial and strategic impact of Stripe's platform (from revenue optimization to operational efficiency) and translates that into the business cases that underpin Stripe's largest and most complex deals. We help drive meaningful business outcomes and accelerate decision-making through a consultative approach that aims to build investment confidence and elevate CxO conversations.

The Business Value Scale Analyst joins at a moment when the BVC team is expanding its impact across Stripe’s broader GTM organization through systematic programs, financial modeling, thought leadership, and data-driven insights. Work product by the Business Value Scale Analyst will directly influence Stripe’s most consequential deals.

What you'll do

The Business Value Scale Analyst is a new role that requires intellectual curiosity, judgment, proactivity, analytical rigor, and strong communication skills. They partner closely with the broader team to design and operationalize programmatic tooling, economic frameworks, data-driven financial models, and user-facing presentations that deal teams will deploy in Stripe’s most complex and high-stakes customer conversations.

Responsibilities

  • Financial model development and ownership: Design, build, QA, and maintain enterprise-grade value tools (ROI and TCO models, payback and NPV analyses, sensitivity and scenario models, competitive benchmarks)
  • Automation and tooling: Engineer integrations between Stripe's internal data sources and value-delivery tooling to automate the generation of financial outputs, narratives, and sales artifacts at scale
  • Code-driven workflows: Apply Python, SQL, and JavaScript to build and maintain data pipelines, automate model generation, and produce formatted outputs that GTM teams can deploy directly in customer conversations
  • Assumptions governance: Build and maintain a documented, version-controlled assumptions library with sourced benchmarks, sign-off workflows, and audit trails, ensuring every model is defensible in a senior customer or board-level context
  • Usage instrumentation: Instrument tools to track GTM adoption, depth of engagement, and output usage. Bring the same analytical rigor to measuring the program's own impact that you apply to the models themselves
  • Scalable solutions: Create reusable templates and modules and build a library of repeatable solutions that accelerate value delivery across the organization
  • Cross-functional partnership: Coordinate across various teams at Stripe to keep benchmarks current and credible, ensure broad scale adoption, and develop innovative solutions

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2–4 years of professional experience in management consulting, strategy consulting, investment banking, corporate finance, strategic finance, or a fintech, SaaS, or technology role with financial exposure
  • Strong business analysis and financial modeling skills (unit economics, ROI and TCO analysis, sensitivity and scenario modeling, NPV and payback calculations)
  • Working coding experience applied to analytics, automation, or data workflows (Python, SQL, or JavaScript)
  • Effective cross-functional communication and ability to translate between financial outcomes and technical products in simple terms
  • Excellent attention to detail with a governance mindset as assumptions must be sourced, versioned, and defensible

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building interactive tools or analytical models for broad use
  • Experience with BI/visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Mode) for building dashboards and adoption analytics
  • Exposure to value consulting, deal pricing, or commercial strategy in a SaaS/enterprise technology environment
  • Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent

raw.description:
Unlock the power of Safety- and Mission-Critical Engineering with QDSS. We are seeking exceptional individuals to join our elite team- where your expertise will make an impact that matters. Elevate your career in a company dedicated to excellence and the pursuit of safety and mission success.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions (QDSS) is seeking a Chief Software Engineer with deep experience in mission- and safety-critical software, working within an engineering services model, supporting aerospace and defense programs.

This role builds on strong software architecture experience and expands into a broader technical authority responsible for guiding how engineering is executed across multiple programs and customers. It is a customer-facing leadership position with accountability for technical direction, execution, and consistency of delivery.

You will work directly with customer engineering leadership to shape software architecture, align on certification approach, and ensure teams are set up to deliver effectively. This includes translating requirements, contractual scope, and certification constraints into a clear and executable technical strategy.

This role requires a balance of:

  • Technical depth in DO-178C (DAL A–C) systems
  • Experience working directly with customers
  • Ability to guide multiple teams and programs
  • Understanding of how to deliver within a services-based model

Due to the nature of the work, all applicants must be U.S. citizens.

This role can be done remotely with up to 25% travel. Preference is given to candidates who reside in Scottsdale, Minneapolis, or Cincinnati.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Customer-Facing Architecture Leadership
    • Act as the primary technical point of contact between our engineering teams and customer leadership
    • Turn customer requirements, contract scope, and certification needs into a clear, executable architecture approach
    • Lead architecture discussions, trade studies, and key technical decisions with customer stakeholders
    • Help guide customer technical direction while staying aligned with program scope and delivery commitments
    • Present architecture, compliance approach, and technical risks in customer and executive reviews
    • This isn’t a back-office architect role. You’ll be directly involved in active programs, working side-by-side with customers and delivery teams.
  • Mission & Safety-Critical Architecture Ownership
    • Define and lead software architecture for embedded, real-time, high-assurance systems
    • Ensure alignment with key standards and processes, including:
      • DO-178C (DAL A–C)
      • ARP4754A system allocations
      • Safety assessments and hazard mitigation
      • Certification objectives and supporting evidence
    • Drive core architectural decisions around:
      • Modernization approaches
      • Partitioning strategy
      • Interface design
      • Timing and resource management
      • Fault containment and system robustness
      • Safety-driven design patterns
  • Engineering Services Delivery Model Integration
    • This role operates in a services-based delivery environment, not an internal OEM setup. That means architecture has to support execution just as much as design.
    • Define architecture in a way that enables:
    • Multiple scrum teams working in parallel
    • Coordination across distributed teams (onshore/offshore as needed)
    • Clear breakdown of work into executable packages
    • Structure architecture artifacts to support:
    • Traceability to the Statement of Work
    • Milestone-based delivery and billing
    • Predictable integration and verification progress
    • Contribute to proposals by helping define:
      • ROM estimates
      • Effort breakdowns
      • Technical risks
      • Staffing plans based on system complexity
  • Team Technical Leadership & Oversight
    • Provide hands-on architectural guidance across multiple engineers and/or scrum teams
    • Help break down requirements into clear, testable, and implementable components
    • Mentor engineers at all levels in safety-critical development practices
    • Lead design reviews, interface reviews, and technical quality checks
    • Ensure consistency in how solutions are implemented across teams
  • Certification & Compliance Strategy
    • Lead planning and alignment for certification artifacts, including:
      • PSAC inputs
      • SDP/SVP alignment
      • Traceability approach
      • Tool qualification considerations (DO-330, if applicable)
    • Work closely with customer DERs and certification authorities as needed
    • Make architectural decisions with certification in mind to reduce downstream risk
  • Technical Risk & Program Health Management
    • Identify architectural risks early (multicore timing, partitioning issues, interface changes, unstable requirements)
    • Put mitigation plans in place and tie them to program milestones
    • Support internal and customer reviews with clear, data-driven risk updates
    • Ensure the architecture supports predictable integration and verification

Required Qualifications:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
  • Significant experience architecting DO-178C compliant software (DAL A experience preferred)
  • Background working in an engineering services or supplier delivery environment
  • Proven ability to lead software architecture across multiple teams and programs
  • Solid embedded software foundation (C/C++ in avionics-type environments)
  • Experience working directly with customers on regulated aerospace programs

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting major aerospace OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers.
  • ARINC 653 or partitioned RTOS environments.
  • Multicore certification strategy.
  • Model-based development exposure (DO-331 context).
  • Integration lab or iron-bird environment exposure.
  • Experience building or scaling Centers of Excellence or capability-based delivery teams.

The QDSS Advantage:

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future.

What You’ll Find Here

  • Work That Matters – Next-generation, safety- and mission-critical projects where your contributions have real-world impact.
  • Growth That’s Supported – Competitive compensation, employer-matched 401(k), certification assistance, and clear opportunities for advancement.
  • A Culture That Works – A flexible, collaborative, and people-first environment where teamwork, innovation, and balance are valued.

Benefits Include

  • Competitive pay, comprehensive medical/dental/life and disability coverage, 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, friendly workplace.

Full compensation package is based on candidate experience and certifications

Pay Ranges
$160,000—$190,000 USD

From next-generation aerospace solutions to cutting-edge defense systems, we tackle the toughest, mission-critical challenges that keep people safe and push the boundaries of innovation. This is where problem-solvers, innovators, and visionary thinkers come together to shape the future. With over 25 years of aerospace and defense engineering expertise, our commitment to delivering high-quality, transformative solutions sets us apart — not just as an industry leader, but as a driving force for impactful change. Together, we’re not just leading the industry — we’re revolutionizing it.

Work setup: Remote

The Network Engineer II role is to ensure that industry best practices and methodologies are applied to deployment and migration of customer VMWare VeloCloud, firewall, route/switch and data center networks. This individual provides technical guidance and leadership to the customer and project management team and ensures project timelines are being met. They will be the technical point of contact for the customer and provide migration and deployment services.

The Network Engineer II will work as part of a team that provides implementation & migration planning for new and existing customer projects. The role is responsible for leading all the technical efforts to successfully migrate a new customer into the platform. The Network Engineer II will be responsible for providing implementation support, which includes advanced networking troubleshooting and management of overall health of services migrating into the managed cloud. The positionwill be a key factor in providing a great customer experience pre & post implementation.

What does a day in the life as a Network Engineer (SD-WAN) look like?

  • Responsible for the delivery of network implementation & optimization services as a post sales engineer to clients.
  • Create or update Low Level and High-Level design of data center networks utilizing industry best practices.
  • Support the delivery of network solutions including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers and other network hardware appliances including VMWare VeloCloud
  • Oversee/perform new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades.
  • Perform configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of customer managed hardware, software.
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed.
  • Conduct research on network products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the networking industry.
  • Provision new or existing customers and provide onboarding assistance.
  • Provide support on escalated trouble cases when necessary.
  • Familiarize with entire environment and execute initiatives to reduce failures, defects, and improve overall performance.
  • Document installations, procedures, and processes for use by other engineers and support.
  • On-call support is a requirement of this position.

What are the required qualifications of a Network Engineer (SD-WAN)?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Must have at least 2 years of experience deploying, and implementing VMWare VeloCloud/SD-WAN, core route/switch and/or data center networks in accordance with industry best practices.
  • Passionate, collaborative, results oriented capable of inspiring and building cross functional high performing relationships to effectively drive change while achieving established goals.
  • Ability to form strong cross-functional relationships and influence others to ensure that business initiatives are achieved.
  • Exceptional level of skill in both oral and written communications and the ability to effectively present ideas and information.
  • Experience with logical network design models (L2/L3, WAN, Network Optimization, Spanning tree, VFR, VTP, VLANs, physical cabling).
  • Working technical knowledge of network control protocols (QOS, PfR, PoE, NTP, DHCP), network management protocols (CDP, FTP, TFTP, SNMP) and security protocols (SSH, HTTPS, AAA, IPSec).
  • Experience with Cisco ISE (Identity Services Engine), as well as Trustsec desired.
  • Working technical knowledge of advanced Layer 2 technologies (LISP and VXLAN)
  • Knowledge of IP communication and routing is required (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP).
  • Understanding WAN/LAN and transport technologies (Ethernet, Frame Relay, DMVPN, WAAS and MPLS).
  • Experience with large-scale WAN deployments preferred.
  • 2 or more years' experience working in WAN (Wide Area Network) is desired.
  • SD-WAN (VeloCloud & Fortinet) implementation and migration experience desired.
  • Firewall experience with managing Fortigate, Cisco, Meraki, and Palo Alto required.
  • Certifications in CCNA, CCNP, or Fortinet NSE desired.
  • Highly adaptable to changes in priorities and business conditions while still driving towards results.
  • Experience in delivering world class customer experience.

Network:

  • IPv4, IPv6
  • VLANs
  • VPNs (IPSec configuration/troubleshooting)
  • QoS
  • Subnetting
  • NAT
  • Port translation
  • Spanning tree
  • LACP, port channeling, and VPCs
  • HSRP

WHO WE ARE

We’re Hook—an award-winning creative content agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team and an emphasis on production-led design, we make ads, campaigns, and experiences that drive growth for the world’s most innovative brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster, but we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

WHAT’S A SENIOR ART DIRECTOR AT HOOK?

A great Senior Art Director is a creative, highly collaborative talent who excels at balancing hands-on design craft with creative direction. They are a positive, inspiring partner who is a joy to work with.

Solves complex marketing challenges through solid conceptual thinking and exceptional design. They are proficient at establishing trust with clients, confidently presenting creative work, and leading projects from ideation through execution alongside motion designers, writers, and motion designers. They have experience in digital marketing, social media landscapes, production, and technology. They have a highly collaborative creative process to generate successful, visually stunning advertising solutions.

Develop an understanding of the client’s products, UI features, and target audiences. This retained brand knowledge enables them to translate complex product features into clear, engaging stories. A Senior AD actively supports the ACD team on pitching, ideation, and design, keeping projects running smoothly and proactively identifying potential issues before they disrupt a project.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Hands-on Concepting & Execution: Collaborate with a writing partner to develop insight-driven creative concepts, executing the visual design to a standard that exceeds client expectations.
  • Design & Concepting: This role entails creating and guiding visually appealing designs and concepts, coming up with ideas and making content for social and digital campaigns. It will be important even when working with tight budgets.
  • Client Relationships: Establish and maintain positive relationships with all relevant client contacts, becoming an expert on brand culture, politics, products, preferences, and expectations.
  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Design and Motion teams to refine and adjust processes to push the work further and find efficiencies.
  • Communication: Be a clear and effective communicator to the team and trusted partner to the production team
  • Creative Partnership: Partner with a Senior Copywriter and create inspiring work that drives storytelling across media
  • Presentations: Lead the development and presentation of pitch materials for all major and complex campaigns associated with a brand or brand group
  • High Quality: Ensure the highest possible quality of all strategic, creative, and design deliverables within the scope of one or more brand relationships
  • Push the Work: Elevate overall work quality by setting increasingly high standards and articulating ambitious creative opportunities (without sacrificing baseline deliverable requirements)
  • Work Relationships: Cultivate positive relationships with Design, Copywriting, Motion and Production.
  • Team Cultural Impact: Promote a positive creative culture through teamwork, positive attitude, and leading by example.
  • Travel: Ability to travel and support photo and video shoots depending on briefs

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • 5+ years of creative agency or production company experience across a variety of campaign types
  • Hands-on design experience is a must. This person will be expected to step in and support design and be able to give pixel perfect design feedback to other members of the team
  • Familiarity with motion graphics and ability to collaborate with motion designers and give clear direction
  • Bonus points if you also have hands on brand design and/or motion design experience
  • Strong portfolio that demonstrates your ability to solve complex marketing challenges with diverse tones and for various industries, especially with digital and social-first projects
  • Ability to tell a clear, engaging story using UI features and visuals, understanding of key benefits to users and how to highlight them with limited assets
  • Keep up with industry developments and AI tools
  • Ability to come up with big idea thinking promoting tech services and products is a plus
  • Experience working with tech or well recognized domestic or international brands is a plus
  • Photo and video shoot support and travel will likely be necessary (about less than 10% of the year). Overnight travel may be required.

WHAT ELSE

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a statement of interest that allows us to learn a little more about you.

We are a remote first organization with a “work from wherever” approach (within the US). We're a collaborative group of people who love the internet, and want to create phenomenal work. Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, and more.

At Hook, we value what makes everyone different. We look for the best talent, no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives, which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are. Come join us!

Hook believes in equity and compensation transparency. We’ve designed a 10-level advancement framework that’s applied consistently across disciplines and departments, aligning with our location-based salary ranges. This role is leveled as an L5. We’ll review your location, skills, experience, and other relevant factors during the interview process to determine where you fall within our leveling framework and corresponding salary ranges. Please follow this link to learn more.

Please review our Transparent Compensation Philosophy. We are not currently considering candidates in the Tier 4 market band for this role at this time.

As a Senior member of the team, you work autonomously to ensure optimized site activation and maintenance and you may be asked to mentor junior project coordinators

  • You want to have an impact in a fast-growing company.

  • Establishes site activation timelines with selected sites and coordinates activities to meet planned activation timelines.
  • Communicate with clinical sites during site start-up
